physicalNotes: Radius 0.04549923 Jupiter radii from Cañas et al. 2022 (2022AJ....163....3C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163....3C/abstract): 3,252.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Cañas et al. 2022 (2022AJ....163....3C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163....3C/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.3121181 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
